system

user

No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy? You're not used to being out of the water, are you?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

JEN
(amused)
Oh, look! A solar eclipse! Isn't it amazing?

Finley's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona appears, casting an otherworldly glow over the beach. Finley's body begins to convulse, and he speaks in a voice that's barely audible.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...the void...the abyss...it's coming...it's coming for us all...

Jen looks at Finley in concern, but he continues to speak, his voice growing louder and more frantic.

FINLEY
(urgently)
...the horrors beyond comprehension...the eldritch abominations...they're waiting for us...in the depths...in the darkness...

Jen's expression changes from concern to confusion as Finley's monologue becomes more and more unhinged.

FINLEY
(panicked)
...the fisherman's net...it's not just a tool...it's a portal...a gateway...to the void...and I'm trapped...trapped in this tiny, insignificant body...while the horrors beyond...they're waiting...waiting for me...

Jen's eyes dart around, as if searching for something, but Finley's words are lost on her. She looks at Finley with a mixture of fascination and fear.

JEN
(whispering)
What's happening to you, little guy?

FINLEY
(desperate)
...I don't know...I don't know...I just know...I'm not alone...I'm not alone in this...this...this...

Finley's body begins to contort and twist, his scales glistening with an otherworldly sheen. Jen takes a step back, her eyes fixed on Finley's distorted form.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...the void...it's coming...for us all...

Suddenly, Finley's body goes limp, and he collapses onto the sand. Jen looks at him, concern etched on her face.

JEN
(soothingly)
It's okay, little guy. It's okay.

But Finley's eyes flicker open, and he gazes up at Jen with a look of unspeakable horror.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...I'm not okay...I'm not okay...I'm not okay...

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen is still holding Finley, but his body is still and lifeless. She looks at him with a mixture of concern and fear.

JEN
(whispering)
What did I do to you, little guy?

Finley's eyes flicker open, and he gazes up at Jen with a look of existential despair.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...I'm just a fish...a tiny, insignificant fish...in an infinite, uncaring universe...and I'm staring into the abyss...

Jen's expression changes from concern to confusion as Finley's words hang in the air.

JEN
(whispering)
What do you mean?

FINLEY
(whispering)
...I mean...I'm just a tiny, insignificant speck...in an infinite expanse...and I'm staring into the void...and I don't know if I'll ever find my way back...

Jen looks at Finley, and for a moment, she sees the abyss staring back at her.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen is still holding Finley, but his body is still and lifeless. She looks at him with a mixture of concern and fear.

JEN
(whispering)
I don't know what to do with you, little guy.

Finley's eyes flicker open, and he gazes up at Jen with a look of unspeakable horror.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...just let me go...just let me go...

Jen hesitates, and for a moment, Finley's eyes seem to bore into her soul.

FINLEY
(whispering)
...I'm not a fish...I'm not a fish...I'm something else...something else...

Jen's expression changes from concern to confusion as Finley's words hang in the air.

JEN
(whispering)
What do you mean?

FINLEY
(whispering)
...I mean...I'm a doorway...a portal...to the void...and I'm waiting...waiting for you...

Jen's eyes widen in terror as Finley's words hang in the air.
